timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹12,513.43 Cr (+9.2% YoY), net profit ₹3,020.95 Cr (+40.9% YoY).
Shriram Finance announced committee meetings to be held between May 1 and July 31, 2026, to consider raising funds through debt securities.
Shriram Finance uploaded the audio recording link for its Q4 FY2025-26 earnings call on April 24, 2026.
Shriram Finance held its Q4 FY26 earnings call on April 24, 2026, reporting a 41% YoY surge in quarterly PAT.
Shriram Capital Private Limited, as of March 31, 2026, holds 33,57,28,920 shares (17.84%) of Shriram Finance Limited under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) disclosure.
Moody's upgraded Shriram Finance's long-term corporate family rating to Baa3 from Ba1 following MUFG Bank's 20% equity infusion.
Shriram Finance denied media speculation regarding MUFG seeking majority control.
Shriram Finance Limited changed name of wholly owned subsidiary from Shriram Overseas Investments Limited to Shriram Gilts Limited effective October 15, 2026.
Board of Directors declared an interim dividend of Rs.6.50 per equity share on 23 October 2026.
Shriram Finance Q2FY27 consolidated PAT rises to ₹3,677 Cr
Shriram Finance announced committee meetings to be held between November 1, 2026, and January 31, 2027, to consider issuing NCDs and bonds.
Shriram Finance submitted the audio recording link of the Q2FY27 earnings conference call on October 23, 2026.
Shriram Finance reported Q2FY27 consolidated PAT of ₹3,677 Cr and maintained its cautious growth outlook amid regional monsoon stress.
